prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which country were holders of the FIFA World Cup the last time the UEFA Champions League was won by a club from London?
answer: France. Chelsea, a London club, last won the UEFA Champions League in 2021, when France were the reigning FIFA World Cup holders after winning in 2018.
